lessons.title: SHAPING THE MINDSET + CLASSROOM VOCABULARY
lessons.grammar_topic: Shaping the mindset (grammatika yo'q)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: 'Shaping the mindset' bo'limi; Teacher's book: Lesson 1.
objectives: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganish kerakligini raqamlar bilan tushuntirib bera oladi (2 mlrd, 90%, 1200 soat, 4000 so'z).
IELTS darajalari jadvalini (A1–C2 / 0–9) bilib oladi va o'zining hozirgi o'rnini ko'rsata oladi.
Coin va XP tizimi, kombinatsiya va normativ nima ekanini tushunadi.
Sinfda ustoz bilan ishlatiladigan 20 ta asosiy iborani (CORE) tanib, aytib bera oladi.
Telegram guruhga qo'shiladi va birinchi ovozli normativni qanday topshirishni biladi.
materials: Doska, marker; 'Level–CEFR–IELTS' va 'Qancha soat' jadvallari (tarqatma).
Coin sovg'alar ro'yxati va XP ligalar jadvali (kitobdan chop etilgan).
CORE 20 ibora chop etilgan varaq (har o'quvchiga bittadan).
Telegram guruh havolasi / QR-kod.
timeline: Ustoz o'zini tanishtiradi. Har o'quvchi ismi va nima uchun kelganini 1 gapda aytadi. Har javobdan keyin maqtov (teacher's bookdagi ro'yxat).
Doskaga 'SHAPING THE MINDSET — tushunchani shakllantirish' yoziladi. Hamma navbat bilan javob beradi. Fikrlar doskaga qisqa yoziladi.
2 mlrd / 8 mlrd; internetdagi 90%; TOP universitetlar; 'privilege → 10 yildan keyin minus'. O'quvchilar raqamlarni daftarga yozadi.
CEFR/IELTS jadvali; 1200 soat (o'zbeklar uchun 1680); kuniga 1–5 soat = necha yil jadvali. 'Bu soatlarni kim qiladi?' — o'quvchi.
Kinestet/audial/vizual; 6 marta uchratish qoidasi; 'xato = yaxshi'; 1 kun praktika > 1 hafta nazariya. Velosiped misoli.
Sovg'alar ro'yxati, ligalar, 2/3/4/5 kishilik kombinatsiya coinlari. Kahoot va normativ qanday bo'lishini aytish.
Varaq tarqatiladi. Ustoz o'qiydi → hamma jo'r bo'lib takrorlaydi (2 marta). Keyin 'Simon says' o'yini: ustoz iborani aytadi, o'quvchi bajaradi (Stand up! Open your books!).
Mashq 1–3 sinfda (juftlikda): moslashtirish, 'kim aytadi' va mini-dialog. Kuchli o'quvchilarga STRONG ro'yxat beriladi.
Telegram guruh ochiladi, hamma qo'shiladi. Uyga vazifa: CORE 20 ni 1:30 da ovozli xabar qilib tashlash (1 coin). Kech qolish/telefon qoidasi keyingi darsda kelishiladi.
Bugungi 3 ta asosiy fikrni o'quvchilar o'zi aytadi: 'soatni men qilaman', 'xato — yaxshi', 'ishlatsam esda qoladi'.

intro: Bu darsda grammatika o'tilmaydi. Maqsad — o'quvchida to'g'ri tushuncha (mindset) hosil qilish. Teacher's bookdagi Lesson 1 matni asosida suhbat olib boriladi; pastdagi savol-javob ketma-ketligi shu suhbatning qisqa xaritasi.
presentation: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganishimiz kerak? (hammadan so'raladi)
har xil javoblar — hammasi maqtaladi
Hozir dunyoda nechta odam ingliz tilida gaplashadi?

Internetdagi ma'lumotning nechi foizi ingliz tilida?

IELTS 6.0 olish uchun taxminan necha soat kerak?
1200 soat (o'zbeklar uchun 1680)
Shu soatlarni kim qilishi kerak — ustozmi, o'quvchimi?
o'quvchi
Kino ko'rish 1200 soatga kiradimi? Musiqa-chi?
kino — ha (lekin samarasi kam), musiqa — yo'q
6.0 uchun nechta so'z bilish kerak? Bitta so'z esda qolishi uchun necha marta uchratish kerak?

Eng zo'r usul qaysi — nazariya yoki praktika?

Xato qilsangiz bu yomonmi?

notes: Suhbat monolog bo'lmasin: har 2–3 daqiqada savol bering va javobni kuting. O'quvchi raqamni o'zi aytsa, esida qoladi.
Statistikani doskaga KATTA yozing: 2 000 000 000 / 90% / 1200 / 4000 / 6.
Kuchli o'quvchilarni ham, sekinlarini ham birinchi darsdayoq maqtang — bu darsning maqsadi qo'rquvni olib tashlash.

how: Bu ro'yxat sinfda har kuni eshitiladigan iboralar. CORE 20 — har bir o'quvchi majburiy biladi (ustoz shu iboralarni faqat inglizcha aytadi). STRONG va SUPER — kuchli o'quvchilar uchun.
Usul: ustoz iborani aytadi va harakat bilan ko'rsatadi → hamma takrorlaydi → ustoz faqat harakatni ko'rsatadi, o'quvchi iborani aytadi.

lessons.title: TO BE + ADJECTIVE
lessons.grammar_topic: To be + adjective (am / is / are + sifat)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 1 (Unit 1, Exercise 1–3); Teacher's book: Lesson 2.
objectives: am / is / are ni egaga qarab to'g'ri tanlaydi (I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are).
'Subject + am/is/are + adjective' formulasida tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzadi.
Ismlar va so'z birikmalarini olmoshga moslashtiradi (my sister = she, Ali and Vali = they).
20 ta CORE sifatni tarjimasi bilan biladi va ular bilan o'zi, oilasi, do'sti haqida gap tuzadi.
'How are you?' savoliga kamida 5 xil javob beradi.
materials: Doska; formula jadvali (katta qilib doskaga yoki plakat).
Kahoot: 'Shaping the mindset' savollari (10 ta).
CORE 20 sifat varag'i (transkripsiya + misol gap bilan).
Mashq 5 uchun 'Find someone who…' jadvali chop etilgan.
timeline: Har o'quvchidan 'How are you?' so'raladi; aytilgan javob takrorlanmaydi (teacher's book ro'yxati doskaga: fine, thanks / not bad / great / I'm doing well…).
Mindset raqamlari bo'yicha 10 savol. 1–3-o'rin coin oladi.
3 kishilik guruhlar, 5 daqiqa tayyorlanish, 1:40–2:00 da CORE 20 ni aytib berish (3 coindan).
Formula jadvali ochiladi. Ustoz so'raydi, o'quvchi topadi (pastdagi jadval). Egani moslashtirish: my sister → she, Ali and Vali → they.
Ustoz o'qiydi → jo'r takror (2 marta). Har so'zga o'quvchilar o'zi haqida bitta gap tuzadi: 'I am busy'. Transkripsiyaga e'tibor: /ˈbɪzi/, /ˈhʌŋɡri/.
2 kishilik: formula → gap → tarjima. Warm-up 1 daqiqada 1 marta; normativ 1 daqiqada 3 marta (1 coin); 4 marta — 2 coin.
Yakka/juftlikda. Ustoz aylanib yuradi, xatolarni darrov to'g'rilaydi. Tez tugatganlar STRONG ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan gap tuzadi.
O'quvchilar turib bir-biridan 'Are you hungry?' deb so'raydi, ism yozadi. Oxirida 3–4 o'quvchi natijani aytadi: 'Dilnoza is tired'.
Uyga vazifa tushuntiriladi: normativ ovozli xabar, kitobdagi Exercise 1–2, yozma mashqlar. Coinlar jurnalga yoziladi.

intro: TO BE — ingliz tilidagi eng asosiy fe'l. O'zbek tilida 'men aqlliMAN' desak, '-man' qo'shimchasi ishini inglizchada 'am' bajaradi. Shuning uchun formula: Ega + am/is/are + sifat.
Bu darsda faqat sifat bilan tuzamiz; a/an YO'Q (a/an faqat ot oldida keladi — keyingi dars).
formulas: I am clever. / She is busy. / They are tired.
Men aqlliman. / U band. / Ular charchagan.
I am not hungry. / He isn't rich. / We aren't sad.
Men och emasman. / U boy emas. / Biz xafa emasmiz.
Are you tired? / Is she happy? / Am I late?
I'm, you're, he's, she's, it's, we're, they're; isn't, aren't
I'm fine. She's clever. They aren't busy.
Men yaxshiman. U aqlli. Ular band emas.
presentation: Bugungi mavzumiz nima ekan?
To be + adjective
Adjective so'zining tarjimasi?
Sifat
Formulasi qanaqa ekan?
Subject + am/is/are + adjective
Subject nima degani?
Ega
Birinchi misol: I'm clever — tarjimasi?
Men aqlliman
Bu gapda ega qaysi? I uchun am/is/are dan qaysi biri?
I; am
You uchun? He/she/it uchun? We/they uchun?
are; is; are
'My sister' — u he/she/it/they dan qaysi biri o'rnida? 'Ali and Vali'-chi?
she; they
Negative form nima degani? Uni yasash uchun nima qo'shamiz va qayerga?
Inkor; not — am/is/are dan keyin
Question form nima degani? Savol tuzish uchun nimani nimadan oldinga chiqaramiz?
Savol; am/is/are ni egadan oldinga
Bu gapda a/an bormi: 'I am clever'? Nega yo'q?
Yo'q — a/an faqat ot oldida keladi, clever — sifat
notes: O'quvchi 'I am a happy' deb qo'ysa — darrov to'xtating: sifat oldida a/an bo'lmaydi. Bu eng ko'p uchraydigan xato.
Egani moslashtirish jadvalini (kitob: 'Egani moslash') doskaga chizing: my mother → she, my parents → they, my phone → it, you and I → we.
Kombinatsiyada o'quvchi formulani, keyin gapni, keyin tarjimani aytadi — uchalasini ham talab qiling.
Yangi so'zlar bilan gap tuzdirganda o'quvchi faqat o'zi haqida emas, sinfdoshi haqida ham tuzsin: 'Aziz is tall' — shunda is ham mashq bo'ladi.
mistakes: Savolda to be egadan oldinga chiqadi.
Isn't he clever? / Is he clever?

how: Kitobdagi 144 ta sifatdan birinchi 60 tasi shu darsga (eng oddiy va kundalik), qolgan 60 tasi 3-darsga, oxirgi 24 tasi 14-darsga bo'lindi. CORE 20 — birinchi darsga kelgan 0-bola uchun ham eplaydigan so'zlar.
Har so'zni 3 qadamda bering: (1) ustoz aytadi, sinf takrorlaydi; (2) o'quvchi tarjimasini aytadi; (3) o'quvchi o'zi haqida gap tuzadi.
core: They are not rich, they are poor.
super: I am nervous before the test.
normativ: Og'zaki: CORE 20 so'zning har biriga gap tuzib, tarjimasi bilan 2 daqiqada aytish (Telegram ovozli xabar) — 1 coin.
Yozma (keyingi darsda): CORE 20 so'z o'zbekcha beriladi, 5 daqiqada inglizchasini xatosiz yozish — 2 coin (3 tagacha imlo xatosi mumkin).
STRONG 40: og'zaki 4 daqiqa (+1 coin), yozma 10 daqiqa (+2 coin). SUPER 60: og'zaki 6 daqiqa (+2 coin), yozma 15 daqiqa (+3 coin).

homework.instr: So'zlardan to'g'ri gap tuzing.

homework.instr: Oilangiz a'zolari haqida CORE sifatlar bilan 8 ta gap yozing: 4 ta tasdiq, 2 ta inkor, 2 ta savol. Namuna: My father is strong. My sister isn't lazy. Is my brother clever?
homework.answers: Tekshiruv: har gapda to be to'g'ri; sifat oldida a/an yo'q; 8 ta gap.

lessons.title: TO BE + NOUN (birlik va ko'plik)
lessons.grammar_topic: To be + a/an + noun (birlik); To be + noun-s (ko'plik)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 2–3 (Exercise 1–7); Teacher's book: Lesson 3. Kasb so'zlari (Jobs) to'liq 4-darsda o'tiladi — bu darsda grammatika uchun 12 ta eng oddiy kasb ishlatiladi.
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + a/an + noun' (birlik) va 'Subject + are + noun-s' (ko'plik) formulalarida gap tuzadi.
a va an farqini biladi: undosh tovush oldida a, unli tovush oldida an (a teacher, an engineer).
Ko'plikda a/an tushib qolishini va otga -s qo'shilishini biladi (We are doctors).
Inkor va savol shaklini to be qoidasi bilan yasaydi (He isn't a driver. Is she a nurse?).
Yangi 20 ta CORE sifat bilan 'to be + adjective' gaplarini takrorlaydi va yangi mavzu bilan aralashtirmaydi.
materials: Formula jadvali (birlik / ko'plik) — doskada ikki ustun.
12 ta kasb rasmi (Vocabulary/jobs papkasidagi rasmlar): teacher, doctor, student, engineer, driver, nurse, cook, farmer, singer, lawyer, waiter, pilot.
Adjectives 1 yozma normativ varag'i (o'zbekcha 20 so'z).
CORE 20 'Common adjectives 2' varag'i.
timeline: Har o'quvchi takrorlanmagan javob beradi. Kechikkanlar 'May I come in?' deb kiradi (classroom vocabulary ishlaydi).
20 CORE sifat bo'yicha rasm/tarjima savollari. 1–3-o'rin coin.
O'zbekcha 20 so'z beriladi, 5 daqiqada inglizchasi yoziladi. 3 tagacha imlo xatosi mumkin; so'zni bilmaslik = 2 xato. Xato so'zlarni alohida yozib olish.
Teacher's bookdagi 'Stupid / Clever / Wise' gapi doskaga yoziladi, o'quvchilar daftar muqovasiga yozadi.
Savol-javob (pastdagi jadval). 12 ta kasb rasmi bilan: 'I am a teacher', 'She is an engineer'. a/an — bosh TOVUSHga qarab.
Kim 1 daqiqada eng ko'p gapni tasdiq–inkor–savol qilib aytsa — 1 coin (I am a student / I am not a student / Am I a student?).
Ikkinchi formula: are + noun-s; a/an yo'q. 'We are teachers'. Birlik–ko'plik farqi 2 ta: (1) a/an yo'qoladi, (2) -s qo'shiladi.
Ustoz o'qiydi → takror; har so'zga bitta 'to be + adjective' gap. Kuchli o'quvchilar STRONG/SUPER varaqni oladi.
Yakka va juftlikda. Mashq 5 — rolli o'yin (kasb tanlash).
2 kishilik kombinatsiya (formula → gap → tarjima): birlik va ko'plik. Uyga vazifa va Jobs lug'ati (4-darsga) tushuntiriladi.

intro: O'tgan darsda to be dan keyin SIFAT qo'ydik (I am clever). Bugun OT qo'yamiz (I am a teacher). Ot oldida a/an keladi — bu eng muhim farq.
a — undosh tovush bilan boshlangan ot oldida (a doctor, a university /juː/); an — unli tovush bilan boshlangan ot oldida (an engineer, an hour /aʊə/). Yozilishiga emas, O'QILISHIGA qarab!
Ko'plikda a/an yo'q, otga -s qo'shiladi va to be faqat 'are' bo'ladi: We are doctors. They are students.
formulas: I am a teacher. / He is an engineer.
I am not a doctor. / She isn't a nurse.
Men shifokor emasman. / U hamshira emas.
Are you a student? / Is he a driver?
We are doctors. / They are students.
This is an apple. These are apples.
presentation: O'tgan mavzumiz nima edi? Adjective tarjimasi?
To be + adjective; sifat
Bugungi mavzumiz? Noun nima degani?
To be + a/an + noun; ot
Formulada ot qayerda keldi? Misollardagi otlar qaysilar?
Oxirida; engineer, florist, teacher, model
Qaysi otlar oldida an, qaysilarida a turibdi? Nimaga qarab?
Unli tovush — an; undosh — a
Kecha sifatlar oldida a/an bor edimi? Demak a/an faqat nima oldidan?
Yo'q; faqat ot oldidan
'Men muhandisman' — qanday bo'ladi? Ega qaysi, ot qaysi?
I am an engineer; I; engineer
Inkor uchun nimani qayerga qo'yamiz?
not — am/is/are dan keyin, otdan oldin
Savol uchun am/is/are ni nima qilamiz? 'Men muhandismanmi?'
Oldinga chiqaramiz; Am I an engineer?
Ikkinchi formulada 'plural' degan so'z bor — nima degani?
Ko'plik
Ko'plikda to be ning qaysi shakli? Birlikda bor, ko'plikda yo'q narsa nima?
are; a/an
Ko'plikda otga nima qo'shiladi? 'Biz shifokorlarmiz'?
-s; We are doctors
notes: a/an ni 'unli HARF' deb emas, 'unli TOVUSH' deb tushuntiring va darrov 3 misol bering: an hour, a university, a European. Bu 12-darsda yana qaytadi.
Ko'plikda o'quvchilar 'We are a doctors' deydi — a/an ni doskadan ochiq o'chirib ko'rsating.

lessons.grammar_topic: To be + in / on / at / from + place (joy)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 6 (Exercise 5–6, prepozitsiyalar), Places ro'yxati; Teacher's book: Lesson 5 (in/on/at farqi, on holiday / on business).
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + in/on/at + place' formulasida tasdiq, inkor, savol tuzadi (I am at home).
in / on / at farqini asosiy qoida bilan biladi: in — ichida (yopiq joy), on — ustida (yuza), at — aniq nuqta/joy.
'Where are you?' va 'Where are you from?' savollarini beradi va javob beradi.
20 ta CORE joy nomini biladi va har biri bilan qaysi predlog kelishini aytadi (at school, in the park, at the bus stop).
on holiday / on business / at work iboralarini ishlatadi.
materials: Doskada 3 ustunli jadval: IN / ON / AT (misollar bilan).
Places CORE 20 varag'i; Jobs yozma normativ varag'i.
Iloji bo'lsa: Navigate A1 Unit 1 videosi (teacher's bookda tavsiya etilgan).
Mashq 5 uchun shahar xaritasi chizmasi (doskaga oddiy chizma: bank, park, school, hospital…).
timeline: How are you? + Where are you from?
Salomlashish. Yangi savol kiritiladi: 'Where are you from?' — 'I'm from Bekobod'. Hammadan so'raladi.
CORE 20 o'zbekcha → inglizcha, 8 daqiqa, 5 tagacha xato.
Teacher's book: to be ni 5 darsda maydalab o'tishning sababi — 'bir qozon ovqatni bir yo'la emas, qoshiqlab'. Chala o'quvchi bo'lmaslik.
I'm from Uzbekistan → to be qani? from — preposition. Location — joy. I'm at home / at school / My father is at work. IN/ON/AT jadvali: keys in the drawer, keys on the table, he is at the bus stop.
Har joy nomi bilan predlogi birga: at school, at home, in the park, at the bus stop. O'quvchi: 'I am at …' / 'My mother is in …'. Where is …? savoli.
on holiday / on business / at work
Uchta ibora doskaga: I am on holiday (dam olishda), on business (xizmat safarida), at work (ishda). Har o'quvchi bittasi bilan gap.
2 kishilik: formula → gap → tarjima. Warm-up 1 daqiqada 1 marta; normativ 1 daqiqada 4 marta (1 coin); 5 marta (2 coin).
Yakka/juftlikda. Mashq 5 — 'Where is Aziz?' xarita o'yini.
Kitob: Exercise 5 (predloglar), Exercise 6 (is/isn't/are/aren't + tarjima). Reading Topic 1–9 tarjimasi keyingi darsga (6-dars) beriladi. Places og'zaki normativ.

intro: Beshinchi va oxirgi 'to be' formulasi: to be + PREDLOG + JOY. O'zbekchada '-da' qo'shimchasi (uyDA, maktabDA) — inglizchada in / on / at.

IN — ichida, yopiq joy: in the box, in the room, in Tashkent (shahar/davlat ham 'ichida'). ON — ustida, yuzada: on the table, on the wall, on the beach. AT — aniq nuqta, 'manzil': at home, at school, at work, at the bus stop, at the door.
Boshqa predloglar (under, behind, next to, between…) 6-darsda alohida lug'at bo'lib o'tiladi; bu darsda ular faqat tanishtiriladi.
FROM — '-dan': I am from Bekobod. Savol: Where are you from? (where = qayer/qayerda — o'zi predlogsiz keladi: Where are you? — Qayerdasan?).
formulas: I am at home. / She is in Tashkent. / The book is on the table.
Men uydaman. / U Toshkentda. / Kitob stol ustida.
I am not at school. / They aren't in the park.
Men maktabda emasman. / Ular parkda emas.
Are you at university? / Is he at work?

I'm from Uzbekistan; am

Predlog; -da, -dan

Inkor qanday? Savol qanday?
not — to be dan keyin; to be oldinga

dam olishda (UK) / dam olishda (US, maktab ta'tili ham) / xizmat safarida
notes: in/on/at ning 'aniq' qoidasi yo'q — 3 ta asosiy fikrni bering (ichida / ustida / nuqta) va 'qolganini yodlaysiz' deng. O'quvchi qoidani tushunsa ko'p joyda o'zi topadi.

at home, at school, at work, at university, at the bus stop — 'at' bilan; in the park, in the garden, in the kitchen, in Tashkent — 'in' bilan; on the beach, on the wall, on the floor — 'on' bilan. Shu 3 guruhni doskada rangli qilib qoldiring.
Where savoli bilan predlog qo'yish xatosi: 'Where are you at?' — XATO (og'zaki AmE da bor, biz o'rgatmaymiz).
Bu dars — to be blokining oxiri. Keyingi darsda 5 formula birga takrorlanadi (Boss level) va 2 darsdan keyin 1-progress test.
mistakes: home, school, work, university — at bilan.

lessons.title: TO BE (PRESENT) — BOSS LEVEL + this/that/these/those + my/your
lessons.grammar_topic: To be (hozirgi zamon) — 5 formula birgalikda, savol so'zlari, qisqa javoblar; this/that/these/those; my/your/his/her (mini-blok)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: BOSS LEVEL — to be present (jadval), Exercise 7 (to be summary), Reading Topic 1–9; Teacher's book: Lesson 6.
objectives: To be ning 5 formulasini bitta jadvalda ko'radi va istalgan formulada tez gap tuzadi.
What / Where / Who / How old savol so'zlari bilan to be savolini tuzadi va qisqa javob beradi (Yes, I am / No, he isn't).
20 ta CORE o'rin predlogini biladi va narsalar qayerdaligini aytadi (The cat is under the table).
Birinchi marta ingliz tilida qisqa matn o'qib, T/F savollariga javob beradi.

intro: BOSS LEVEL — yangi mavzu yo'q. 5 ta formula bitta jadvalda: to be + adjective / + noun / + adj + noun / + place / this-that. Maqsad — o'quvchi o'ylanmasdan to'g'ri shaklni tanlashi.
Yangi qo'shiladigan kichik narsalar: savol so'zlari (What, Where, Who, How old) va qisqa javoblar (Yes, I am. No, I'm not. Yes, she is. No, they aren't).

MINI-BLOK 1 — KO'RSATISH: this (bu — yaqin, birlik), that (anavi — uzoq, birlik), these (bular — yaqin, ko'plik), those (anavilar — uzoq, ko'plik). This is a pen. That is a board. These are books. Those are windows.

MINI-BLOK 2 — EGALIK SIFATLARI (doim OT bilan): my (mening), your (sening/sizning), his (uning — o'g'il), her (uning — qiz), its (uning — narsa), our (bizning), their (ularning). My name is Aziz. Your book is on the desk. Her bag is red.
Ikkala mini-blok to be bilan ishlaydi: This is my pen. Those are their bags. Is that your teacher? — Yes, he is.

reading.title: My family at home
text: My name is Nilufar. I am fourteen and I am a student. I am from Bekobod. Now I am at home with my family. Our house is big and clean. It is near the park.
My father is an engineer. He is at work now. My mother is a nurse. She isn't at the hospital today — she is in the kitchen. She is a very good cook!

My brother Aziz is ten. He is a funny boy. He is in the garden behind the house. His football is under the tree. My grandparents are old but they are healthy. They are in the living room. The TV is in front of them.
Our cat Mimi is small and lazy. Where is she? She is on the sofa, between my grandfather and my grandmother. We are a happy family!

lessons.grammar_topic: Present continuous — hozirgi davomiy zamon (am/is/are + verb-ing)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 11 (Unit 2 — Present continuous, 8 ta mashq), Reading Topic 10–12; Teacher's book: Lesson 9. Listening: Audio 6–16.
objectives: 'Subject + am/is/are + verb-ing' formulasida hozir bo'layotgan ish-harakatni aytadi (I am sleeping).
-ing qo'shish qoidalarini biladi: play → playing, write → writing (e tushadi), swim → swimming (undosh ikkilanadi).
Inkor va savol shaklini to be qoidasi bilan yasaydi; Wh-savollar (What are you doing?) tuzadi.

Ustoz fe'lni aytadi, o'quvchi harakatni qiladi; keyin o'quvchi harakat qiladi, sinf aytadi: 'He is jumping!'. -ing shaklini birga yozish.

intro: Bugundan ZAMONLAR boshlanadi. Birinchi zamon — Present Continuous: HOZIR bo'layotgan ish. Formula: ega + am/is/are + fe'l + ing. Ya'ni to be ning hozirgi shakli + fe'l-ing.
O'zbekchada '-yapman / -yapti': I am sleeping — uxlayapman; It is raining — yomg'ir yog'yapti.

-ING qoidalari: (1) oddiy: play → playing, read → reading; (2) fe'l -e bilan tugasa e tushadi: write → writing, make → making, come → coming; (3) qisqa fe'l 'undosh+unli+undosh' bilan tugasa oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: swim → swimming, run → running, sit → sitting, stop → stopping.
Belgi so'zlar: now, at the moment, right now, today (hozirgi vaziyat), Look! Listen! (hozir bo'layotgan narsaga e'tibor).
formulas: I am sleeping. You are playing. He is reading. It is raining.

-ing qoidasini doskada 3 ustunda qoldiring; har yangi fe'lni o'quvchi o'zi ustunga joylasin.
'Now I am go to school' — eng ko'p xato: fe'lga -ing qo'shilmaydi. 'I going' — to be tushadi. Ikkalasini ochiq ko'rsating.
Present continuous ni odatiy ish uchun ishlatmang (I am go to school every day — XATO) — bu 9-darsda Present simple bilan solishtiriladi.

reading.title: Sunday afternoon at our house
text: It is Sunday afternoon and everybody is at home. I am sitting in the living room and I am writing this text for my English lesson. My father is in the garden. He is washing the car and he is singing — very loudly!

My mother is in the kitchen. She is cooking plov and she is talking on the phone with my aunt. My little sister isn't helping her — she is drawing a picture of our cat. The cat is sleeping on the sofa. It isn't moving.
My brother is at the stadium. He is playing football with his friends. Look! It is raining now. Is he coming home? No, he isn't. He is still playing!
What are you doing now? Are you reading? Yes, you are — you are reading my text!

intro: BE GOING TO — reja, niyat: 'men … -moqchiman'. Formula: ega + am/is/are + going to + FE'L (1-shakl). I am going to sleep — Men uxlamoqchiman.
To be bo'lgani uchun inkor va savol o'sha-o'sha: I'm not going to sleep. Are you going to sleep?

Present continuous ham kelajak uchun ishlatiladi — ANIQ kelishilgan reja bo'lsa (vaqt, joy aniq): I'm going out this weekend. I'm getting a new job on Monday. Going to — umumiy niyat, vaqt-joy aniq emas: I'm going to get a new job (qachondir).
O'zbek tilida ham shunday: 'Ertaga Toshkentga ketyapman' (aniq reja, hozirgi zamon shakli) — 'Toshkentga bormoqchiman' (niyat).
Diqqat: 'I'm going to go out' (going to + go) va 'I'm going out' (present continuous, go fe'li) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi boshqacha.
formulas: I am going to sleep. She is going to cry. It is going to rain.

reading.title: Plans for the weekend
text: It is Friday evening and my family is talking about the weekend. My father is going to wash the car and fix the door in the kitchen. He isn't going to rest — he never rests on Saturday!
My mother is going to go shopping in the morning. She is meeting her friend at the market at 9 — they always go together. In the afternoon she is going to cook plov for our guests.
My brother is going to play football, of course. His team is playing at the stadium at 4 on Saturday. He isn't going to do his homework — and my mother isn't happy about it.

And me? On Saturday I am going to sleep in! Then I am going to read a book and listen to music. On Sunday we are visiting our grandparents in the village. We are leaving at 8 in the morning. What are you going to do this weekend?

intro: PRESENT SIMPLE — odatiy, doim, har kuni bo'ladigan ish: I go to school every day — Men har kuni maktabga boraman. Formula juda oddiy: ega + fe'l (1-shakl). TO BE YO'Q!
Bu darsda faqat I / you / we / they (base form). He/she/it (fe'lga -s) — keyingi dars.
Inkor: ega + do not (don't) + V1. Savol: Do + ega + V1? Qisqa javob: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Belgi so'zlar: every day / week / morning, always, usually, often, sometimes, never, on Mondays, at 7 o'clock, in the morning (adverbs of frequency — 10-darsda batafsil).
Present continuous bilan farq: NOW → I am going (hozir); EVERY DAY → I go (odat). 'I am go to school every day' — XATO.

reading.title: My day
text: My name is Dilnoza. I am fifteen and I live in Bekobod with my parents and two brothers. I get up at 6 o'clock every day. I don't like early mornings, but I don't have a choice! I make my bed, brush my teeth and have breakfast with my family. We usually drink tea and eat bread with butter.

I leave home at 7:30 and I catch the bus. I arrive at school at 8. I study very hard because I want to go to university. After school I come home, have lunch and take a nap. Then I attend English classes at Jony Academy three times a week. I memorize vocabulary and revise lessons every evening.
In the evening we have dinner together. I do the washing-up and my brothers take out the rubbish. We don't watch TV a lot — we chat and read. I go to bed at 10.
On Sundays I don't get up at 6! I sleep in, I go for a walk with my friends and we eat out. Do you like Sundays? I do!

intro: Present simple da HE / SHE / IT uchun fe'lga -s (yoki -es) qo'shiladi: He plays football. She goes to school. It rains in autumn.

-ES qoidasi: fe'l -o, -sh, -ch, -x, -ss bilan tugasa: go → goes, do → does, watch → watches, wash → washes, fix → fixes, miss → misses. Undosh + y → -ies: study → studies, fly → flies, cry → cries (lekin play → plays — unli + y). Maxsus: have → has.
Inkor: he/she/it + doesn't + V1 (He doesn't play). Savol: Does + he/she/it + V1? (Does she go?). Muhim: doesn't/does bo'lganda fe'l -s OLMAYDI — -s 'does' ichiga o'tib ketadi.

Chastota ravishlari (adverbs of frequency): always (100%) — usually — often — sometimes — rarely/seldom — never (0%). O'rni: oddiy fe'ldan OLDIN (She always drinks tea), to be dan KEYIN (She is always late).
Talaffuz: -s → /s/ (works, gets), /z/ (plays, goes), /ɪz/ (watches, washes).

reading.title: My friend Aziz
text: My best friend is Aziz. He is fifteen and he lives in Bekobod, near my house. He is tall, funny and very hard-working. He studies at my school, but he isn't in my class.

Aziz always gets up at 6 o'clock. He never sleeps in! He has breakfast with his family and then he rides his bike to school. He usually arrives early. After school he goes to the gym three times a week. He loves sport — he plays football at the weekend and he sometimes watches basketball on TV.
In the evening Aziz does his homework and helps his mother. He doesn't watch TV a lot and he doesn't play video games. He often reads books about animals — he wants to be a vet.
Aziz is a good friend. He always helps me with maths and I help him with English. We hardly ever argue!

intro: IMPERATIVE — buyruq, iltimos, maslahat, yo'l ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ega (you) AYTILMAYDI, gap fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan boshlanadi.
POSITIVE: Verb (+ object)! — Stay indoors! (ichkarida qol) / Go away! (yo'qol) / Help me with my homework, please (uyga vazifamga yordam bering).
NEGATIVE: Don't + verb! — Don't run in the hallway! (koridorda yugurma) / Don't eat too much (ko'p yema) / Don't close the door (eshikni yopma).
MULOYIM: please — boshida yoki oxirida: Please sit down. / Sit down, please.
LET'S: Let's + verb — 'keling, …-aylik': Let's go! Let's not talk. (Let's not — inkor.)
Buyruq gap uchun to be: Be quiet! Be careful! Don't be late! (be — asosiy shakl).

Vaqt ravishlari ko'pincha gap OXIRIDA: I'll do it tomorrow. Come here now! Qisqa ravishlar (already, still, just, soon) fe'l OLDIDA yoki to be dan KEYIN: I have just finished. He is still here. I already know.
CAN — qila olmoq (hozir): I can swim — suza olaman. can't = cannot: I can't drive — hayday olmayman. Savol: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Buyruq va so'rov birga: Open the window! (buyruq) → Can you open the window, please? (muloyim so'rov). Can I come in? — ruxsat so'rash.
can dan keyin TO yo'q, -s yo'q: He can swim (He can swims — XATO). Hamma shaxsda bir xil.

reading.title: How to make a good cup of tea
text: Do you want a perfect cup of tea? Follow these steps. First, boil some fresh water. Don't use old water from the kettle — fresh water tastes better.

Then, warm the teapot: pour a little hot water into it, wait ten seconds and pour it out. Put one teaspoon of tea for each person into the pot. Add the hot water and wait for three to five minutes. Don't wait too long — the tea will be bitter!
Now pour the tea into cups. Add milk or sugar if you like. In Uzbekistan, people usually drink green tea without milk. In Britain, people often add milk.
Finally, sit down, relax and enjoy your tea. Don't drink it too fast — it's hot! And remember: always wash the teapot afterwards.

objectives: a/an ni so'zning bosh TOVUSHIga qarab tanlaydi (an hour, a university, a European, an umbrella).

intro: A/AN — noaniq artikl: o'zbekchada yo'q, inglizchada majburiy. Faqat BIRLIKDAGI SANALADIGAN ot oldida: a book, an apple. Ko'plikda yo'q (books), sanalmaydiganda yo'q (water).

a — undosh TOVUSH oldida, an — unli TOVUSH oldida. Yozilishiga emas, o'qilishiga qaraymiz: an hour /aʊə/ (h o'qilmaydi), a university /juː/ (y tovushi bilan boshlanadi), a European /jʊə/, an umbrella /ʌ/, an MP /em/.
Ot oldida sifat bo'lsa, a/an sifatga qaraydi: a red apple, an ugly doll, an old car.
Sanalmaydigan otlar (uncountable): water, milk, sugar, rice, money, bread, information, homework — a/an yo'q, ko'plik -s yo'q. Miqdor: some water, a glass of water, a cup of tea (13-darsda batafsil).

Ko'plik: -s (cats); -es (s, sh, ch, x, o dan keyin: buses, boxes, tomatoes); undosh + y → -ies (babies, cherries); -f/-fe → -ves (wolves, knives); maxsus: man → men, woman → women, child → children, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep, fish → fish, foot → feet, tooth → teeth.
formulas: a + undosh tovush; an + unli tovush

reading.title: At the market
text: On Sunday my mother and I are at the market. It is a big and noisy market in Bekobod. My mother has a list: apples, tomatoes, onions, a watermelon and some rice.
First we are at the fruit shop. An old man is selling apples and grapes. 'A kilo of apples is 8,000 sum,' he says. My mother is choosing red apples. I want a banana, but bananas aren't on the list!
Then we are at the vegetable shop. A young woman is selling carrots, cucumbers and potatoes. Potatoes are cheap today. My mother is buying two kilos of potatoes and an onion.
Look! A cat is sitting under the table. It is watching the fish shop. Fish is expensive today, so the cat isn't happy. And a dog is eating a tomato! What a funny market!

lessons.grammar_topic: There is / are / was / were; some / any; sanalmaydigan otlar bilan
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: BOSS LEVEL — There + to be (3 jadval), some/any mashqlari, Common uncountable nouns (70); Teacher's book: Lesson 13. Listening: Audio 43–51.
objectives: 'There is + a/an + birlik ot' va 'There are + some + ko'plik ot' bilan 'bor' gaplarini tuzadi (There is a cat in the room).
Inkor (There isn't a … / There aren't any …) va savol (Is there a …? Are there any …?) yasaydi.
some (tasdiq) va any (inkor, savol) farqini biladi; sanalmaydigan ot bilan there is some milk / isn't any milk tuzadi.
O'tgan zamonda there was / there were ishlatadi.
20 ta CORE sanalmaydigan otni biladi va ular bilan a glass of / a cup of / a kilo of iboralarini ishlatadi.
materials: 3 jadval (kitob BOSS): there is/was (birlik), there are/were (ko'plik), there is + uncountable.
Xona rasmi (doskaga chizma): stol, 2 stul, 3 kitob, mushuk, deraza — 'What is there in the room?'.
Animals/fruit yozma normativ varag'i; CORE 20 uncountable varag'i.

timeline: Salomlashish + 'What is there in your bag?'
Ustoz sumkasini ochib: 'There is a book. There are two pens.' Hammadan so'raladi.

There is + a/an + birlik → 'bor'. Inkor — 'yo'q', savol — 'bormi?'. Was → 'bor edi'. Ko'plik: there are SOME…; inkor/savol — ANY. Sanalmaydigan: there is some milk / isn't any milk / is there any milk?
So'z → tarjima → 'there is some …' → miqdor: a glass of water, a cup of tea, a kilo of rice, a piece of bread. Jo'r takror.
2 kishilik: 3 jadval ketma-ket (birlik / ko'plik / sanalmaydigan), har birida +, –, ?. 1 daqiqada 2 marta (kitob: 1–2 coin).
Matn 'Our fridge'. T/F, savollar, some/any topish.
Kitob some/any mashqlari; Listening skript; PROGRESS TEST 2 keyingi darsda: grammatika 50 (to be 3 zamon, davomiy zamonlar, a/an, there is/are, some/any), lug'at 50 (7–13-dars CORE so'zlari).

intro: THERE IS / THERE ARE — 'bor' ma'nosida, biror joyda nimadir borligini aytish uchun: There is a cat in the room — Xonada mushuk bor. O'zbekchada 'bor' gap oxirida, inglizchada 'there is' gap boshida!
Birlik: there is + a/an + ot. Ko'plik: there are + SOME + ot-s. Sanalmaydigan: there is + SOME + ot (milk, water, money).
SOME — tasdiq gapda ('bir nechta', 'ozgina'). ANY — inkor va savolda: There aren't any cats. Are there any cats? There isn't any milk. Is there any milk?
O'tgan zamon: there was / there were (inkor: wasn't/weren't; savol: Was there…? Were there…?). Kelasi: there will be.

lessons.title: TO BE (PAST) — was / were
lessons.grammar_topic: To be o'tgan zamon: was / were (birlik, ko'plik, you), inkor, savol
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 7–10 (to be past), 'was/were' mashqi (50 ta gap); Teacher's book: Lesson 7. Listening: Audio 1–5.
objectives: was / were ni egaga qarab tanlaydi: I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were.
To be ning 5 formulasini o'tgan zamonda tuzadi (I was strong / He was a doctor / She was a kind teacher / I was at home).
Inkor (wasn't / weren't) va savol (Was he…? Were you…?) shakllarini yasaydi; qisqa javob beradi.
yesterday, last week, ago, then kabi o'tgan zamon belgilarini ishlatadi.
Ingliz alifbosini to'g'ri talaffuz qiladi va eshitib harflarni yozadi (Listening 1–5).
materials: Progress test 1 varaqlari (tests/test 1) — har o'quvchiga.
was/were jadvali (Level 7–10) doskada: singular / plural / you.
Alifbo plakati; Listening audio 1–5 (telefon/kolonka).
CORE 20 'Adjectives 3' varag'i.
timeline: How are you? / Where were you yesterday? (yangi savol — javobni ustoz beradi: I was at home).
Test 1: grammatika 40 ball (5 formula), lug'at 60 ball (CORE so'zlar). Cheating haqida imzo. Vaqt tugagach varaqlar yig'iladi. Natija keyingi darsda.
Test — o'zini tekshirish, jazo emas. 'Xato qilyapsizmi — o'rganyapsiz'.
Savol-javob: am/is → was, are → were. 5 formula o'tgan zamonda. 'Extra singular' — you har doim were. Inkor: not; savol: was/were oldinga.
Ustoz o'qiydi → takror → o'tgan zamonda gap: 'I was lazy yesterday'. Juft so'zlar: right/wrong, thick/thin, high/low.
2 kishilik: was/were bilan 4 formula (adj / noun / adj+noun / place). Normativ 1 daqiqada 3 marta (1 coin); 4 marta (2 coin).
Alifbo (1), harf guruhlari (2), juft harflar (3–4), qisqartmalar (5). O'quvchi eshitib yozadi; ustoz tekshiradi.
Kitob: was/were mashqi (50 gap); listening 1–5 skriptini daftarga; reading matni.

intro: O'tgan zamon — o'zbekchada '-edi' (kuchli EDIM, shifokor EDI). Inglizchada am/is → WAS, are → WERE. Boshqa hech narsa o'zgarmaydi: 5 formula shundayligicha qoladi.
Ega birlik (I, he, she, it, my mother, Ali) → was. Ega ko'plik (we, they, my parents, Ali and Vali) → were. YOU — birlik bo'lsa ham, ko'plik bo'lsa ham WERE (kitobdagi 'extra singular').
Belgi so'zlar: yesterday (kecha), last week/month/year (o'tgan hafta/oy/yil), two days ago (2 kun oldin), then (o'shanda), in 2020.
formulas: I/he/she/it + was + adj / a-an noun / adj+noun / place
I was strong. He was a doctor. She was a kind teacher. I was at home.
Men kuchli edim. U shifokor edi. U mehribon o'qituvchi edi. Men uyda edim.
we/they/you + were + adj / noun-s / adj+noun-s / place
We were fat. They were great athletes. You were at school.
Biz semiz edik. Ular ajoyib sportchilar edi. Sizlar maktabda edingiz.
I wasn't a vet. They weren't barbers.
Men veterinar emas edim. Ular sartarosh emas edi.
Was he kind? Were you at home?
Yes, S + was/were. / No, S + wasn't/weren't.
Was it cold? — Yes, it was. / No, it wasn't.
Where were you yesterday? — I was at the gym.
Kecha qayerda eding? — Sport zalda edim.
presentation: Shuncha payt to be dedik — hozirgi zamon shakllari qaysi? Nechta formula?
am/is/are; 5 ta
'I am a teacher' — qaysi zamon? Bugun qaysi zamon?
Hozirgi; o'tgan
Kitobda o'tgan zamon birlik shaklida am/is o'rnida nima turibdi?

'Men kuchli edim'? 'I am strong' dan nima o'zgardi?
I was strong; faqat am → was
'U o'qituvchi edi'? 'U aqlli haydovchi edi'? 'U maktabda edi'?
He was a teacher. He was a clever driver. He was at school.
Ko'plik uchun qaysi so'z? 'Biz qo'pol edik'? 'Ular mehnatkash farroshlar edi'?
were; We were rude. They were hard-working janitors.
'Sen qassob eding' — you birlik, lekin was emas — nima?
were — you har doim were
'Sizlar qassob edinglar' — birlikdan farqi?
You were butchers — a/an yo'q, -s bor
Inkorda nima qo'shamiz? Savolda nima qilamiz?
not — was/were dan keyin; was/were oldinga
'Kecha uyda edingmi?' — qisqa javob?
Were you at home yesterday? — Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.
notes: Eng ko'p xato: 'you was'. Doskaga katta qilib: YOU = WERE (har doim). 'I' bilan chalkashadi — I was, lekin you were.
wasn't /ˈwɒznt/, weren't /wɜːnt/ talaffuzini alohida mashq qiling — o'quvchilar 'vosnt' deydi.
Test natijasini keyingi darsda e'lon qiling; 60% dan kam olganlar bilan alohida gaplashing (teacher's book qoidasi).

intro: PAST SIMPLE — o'tgan zamon: kecha, o'tgan hafta bo'lgan, TUGAGAN ish. To'g'ri (regular) fe'llarga -ED qo'shiladi: work → worked, play → played. I worked yesterday — Men kecha ishladim.

Yozuv qoidalari: (1) oddiy: work → worked; (2) -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live → lived, like → liked; (3) undosh + y → -ied: study → studied, cry → cried (play → played — unli + y); (4) qisqa fe'l 'undosh+unli+undosh' → oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: stop → stopped, plan → planned.
Talaffuz: -ed → /t/ jarangsizdan keyin (worked, watched, stopped), /d/ jaranglidan keyin (played, lived, cleaned), /ɪd/ faqat t/d dan keyin (wanted, needed, visited).
Inkor: didn't + V1 (I didn't work — -ed YO'Q!). Savol: Did + ega + V1? (Did you work?). -ed faqat tasdiq gapda. Hamma ega bilan bir xil (he worked, they worked).
was/were (14-dars) — faqat to be ning o'tgan zamoni. 'I was worked' — XATO.

Talaffuz /t/ /d/ /ɪd/ — 3 ustunli jadval; har yangi fe'lni o'quvchi ustunga joylasin. 'workED' deb /ed/ o'qish — xato.

reading.title: My grandmother's story
text: Yesterday my grandmother talked about her life. She lived in a small village near Bukhara. Her family was big — she had five brothers and two sisters. Her father worked as a farmer and her mother cooked for ten people every day!

My grandmother didn't study at university. She finished school and started work at 17. She worked at a cotton factory. She liked her job, but it was hard. In 1975 she married my grandfather. He worked as a teacher in Bekobod, so she moved to Bekobod.
They had four children — my mother, my two uncles and my aunt. My grandmother cleaned, cooked and looked after the children. She didn't have a lot of free time, but she always smiled.
Did she travel a lot? No, she didn't. Did she visit Tashkent? Yes, she did — only once, in 1990. 'I didn't need a lot,' she says. 'I loved my family and my family loved me.'

intro: NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR — o'tgan zamonda -ed OLMAYDI, o'zining alohida 2-shakli bor: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate. Bularni yodlash kerak — kitobda qofiya (ohangdosh) guruhlarga bo'lib berilgan: bring–brought, buy–bought, think–thought, catch–caught, teach–taught.
Formula: ega + V2. He went to Tashkent — U Toshkentga bordi. Inkor va savol — to'g'ri fe'llardagidek, V1 bilan: He didn't go. Did he go? (V2 faqat tasdiqda).
3-shakl (V3: gone, seen, eaten) hozircha faqat jadvalda yodlanadi — u keyingi darajada (Present perfect) kerak bo'ladi.
Ba'zi fe'llar 3 shaklda ham bir xil: cut–cut–cut, put–put–put, cost–cost–cost, hit–hit–hit.

reading.title: Last weekend
text: Last weekend was great. On Saturday I woke up at 8 and had a big breakfast. Then my father drove me to my grandparents' village. My grandmother made samsa and I ate five! My grandfather told me stories about his life. He was a soldier and he saw many countries.

In the afternoon my cousins came. We went to the river and swam. My cousin Bobur caught a fish, but it was very small, so he threw it back. We ran, we sang and we laughed a lot. I didn't want to go home!

On Sunday I slept in. Then I did my homework and read a book. In the evening my mother bought a cake because it was my sister's birthday. She got a lot of presents. I gave her a notebook. Did she like it? Yes, she did!
What did you do last weekend?

intro: Past continuous — o'tgan zamonda DAVOM ETAYOTGAN ish: 'Kecha soat 9 da men uxlayotgan edim'. Formula: ega + was/were + fe'l-ing.
Present continuous dan farqi faqat to be da: am/is/are → was/were. -ing qoidalari o'sha-o'sha (writing, swimming, playing).

Qachon ishlatiladi: (1) o'tgan zamonda aniq vaqtda davom etayotgan ish — yesterday at 5, at that time, at 10 last night; (2) uzoq davom etgan ish — all day, all evening; (3) keyinroq (18-dars): 'when' bilan — When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
Belgi so'zlar: yesterday at …, at that time, last night, all day/evening, at this time yesterday.
PAST SIMPLE bilan birga: qisqa ish — past simple, davomiy fon — past continuous. When the phone RANG, I WAS SLEEPING. While I was cooking, he came. (16-darsdagi V2 shakllar shu yerda kerak.)

reading.title: Yesterday at 6 o'clock
text: Yesterday at 6 o'clock in the evening my family was at home. My mother was cooking dinner in the kitchen and she was listening to music. My father was sitting on the sofa. He was reading a newspaper, but he wasn't reading carefully — he was sleeping a little!
My sister was doing her homework. She was writing and she was looking at her phone at the same time. My brother was playing a computer game. He was winning, so he was shouting: 'Yes! Yes!'

And me? I was standing at the window. It was snowing. The children in the street were throwing snowballs and laughing. The cars were moving slowly. Our dog was watching the children, too. He wasn't happy — he was inside!
What were you doing yesterday at 6 o'clock?

intro: BOG'LOVCHILAR ikki oddiy gapni bitta murakkab gapga bog'laydi — IELTS da murakkab gap yuqori ball beradi.
AND (va): + and + / – and –. I played football and went to school. He didn't study and didn't get into university.
BUT (lekin, ammo): + but – / – but +. I played football but didn't go to school.
SO (shuning uchun): SABAB + so + NATIJA. I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
BECAUSE (chunki): NATIJA + because + SABAB. I didn't go to school because I was ill. Because oldinda kelsa — vergul: Because I was ill, I didn't go to school (kasal bo'lganim uchun).

WHEN (…ganda, …gach): When I wake up, I go for a run (present). When they arrive, we will start (kelajak). When it was raining, I was reading (ikki davomiy). When they finished, they left (ikki past simple). When + past simple, past continuous: When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
ALTHOUGH (garchi…-sa ham): Although it was cold, we went out. HOWEVER (biroq) — yangi gap boshida, vergul bilan: It was cold. However, we went out.
formulas: I played football and went to school. He didn't study hard and didn't get into university.
Men futbol o'ynadim va maktabga bordim. U qattiq o'qimadi va universitetga kirmadi.
I played football but didn't go to school.
Men futbol o'ynadim, lekin maktabga bormadim.
I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun maktabga bormadim.
result + because + cause / Because + cause, result
We stayed indoors because it was raining. Because it was raining, we stayed indoors.
Yomg'ir yog'ayotgani uchun biz ichkarida qoldik.
When + present, present / future; When + past, past
When I wake up, I go for a run. When they arrive, we will start. When it was raining, I was reading. When they finished, they left.
Uyg'onganimda yugurgani chiqaman. Ular kelganda boshlaymiz. Yomg'ir yog'ayotganda o'qiyotgan edim. Tugatganlarida ketishdi.
Although + gap, gap / Gap. However, gap.
Although it was cold, we went out. It was cold. However, we went out.
Sovuq bo'lsa ham, chiqdik. Sovuq edi. Biroq, chiqdik.
presentation: Bugun nima o'tamiz? Conjunctions nima degani? Nechta?
Bog'lovchilar; 7 ta (and, but, so, because, when, although, however)
and tarjimasi? Nechi xil holatda?
'Men futbol o'ynadim va maktabga bordim'? 'Men yaxshi o'qimadim va universitetga kirmadim'?
I played football and went to school. I didn't study hard and didn't get into university.
but tarjimasi? Qanday holatda? 'Men futbol o'ynadim lekin maktabga bormadim'?
lekin; +/– yoki –/+; I played football but didn't go to school
so tarjimasi? Formula? Cause / result nima?
shuning uchun; cause + so + result; sabab / natija
'Men kasal edim, shuning uchun maktabga bormadim'? Sabab qaysi? Natija?
I was ill so I didn't go to school; kasal edim; bormadim
because tarjimasi? so ning teskarisi — birinchi nima keladi?
chunki; result + because + cause
'Men maktabga bormadim chunki kasal edim'? Because oldinda kelsa nima kerak?
I didn't go to school because I was ill; vergul
when — 4 holat: hozirgi odat? kelajak? ikki davomiy? ikki oddiy o'tgan?
When I wake up, I go… / When they arrive, we will start / When it was raining, I was reading / When they finished, they left
'Telefon jiringlaganda men uxlayotgan edim'?
When the phone rang, I was sleeping
notes: so va because — bir-birining teskarisi: doskada bitta gapni ikki xil yozing: I was ill, SO I stayed at home. / I stayed at home BECAUSE I was ill.
when + past simple + past continuous — kitobdagi 17-darsdagi 'when the phone rang' gaplari endi tushunarli bo'ladi; kitob A–E mashqlarini (past simple vs continuous) shu darsda bering.
although/however — faqat kuchli o'quvchilarga; testda tushmaydi.
Test 4 (tests/test 4): future simple, conditionals, past simple; tayyorgarlik uchun 1 marta ko'rsating.
mistakes: I was ill because I didn't go to school.
I didn't go to school because I was ill.
I didn't go to school so I was ill.
I was ill, so I didn't go to school.
When I was sleeping, the phone was ringing.
When the phone rang, I was sleeping.
qisqa ish — past simple, davomiy — continuous.
I played football but I went to school.
I played football and went to school.
Because I was ill I stayed home.
Because I was ill, I stayed home.
Although it was cold but we went out.
Although it was cold, we went out.

reading.title: A bad day
text: Yesterday was a bad day for Aziz. He woke up late because his alarm clock didn't ring. He didn't have breakfast, so he was hungry all morning. When he was running to the bus stop, it started to rain and he didn't have an umbrella!

He arrived at school late, but the teacher didn't shout at him because she understood — the rain was terrible. In the maths lesson Aziz didn't understand the new rule, so he asked the teacher and she explained it again.

After school he went to the shop and bought bread. When he was walking home, he met his friend Bobur. Bobur lent him an umbrella, so Aziz didn't get wet again. At home his mother made hot tea and Aziz felt better.
Although it was a bad day, it ended well. 'Bad days happen,' his mother said, 'but good friends help.'

objectives: will be bilan to be ning 5 formulasini kelasi zamonda tuzadi (I will be a lawyer / We will be at home).
Inkor (won't be) va savol (Will you be…?) shakllarini yasaydi; 'will' ning o'zi emas, 'will be' ekanini biladi.
'Subject + will + V1' formulasida kelasi zamon gaplarini tuzadi (I will go to Tashkent tomorrow); hamma ega bilan will bir xil.

will (o'sha zahoti qaror, taxmin, va'da: I think it will rain / I will help you) va going to (oldindan reja) farqini biladi.
19-darsdagi 'will be' bilan bog'laydi: will + be = to be ning kelasi zamoni; will + boshqa fe'l = future simple.

intro: Kelasi zamonda to be ning BITTA shakli bor: WILL BE (hamma ega uchun). O'zbekcha 'bo'laman / bo'ladi / bo'lamiz'.
Xato: 'I will a doctor' — be tushib qoladi. To be — 'bo'lmoq' fe'li; will — faqat kelasi zamon belgisi. Ikkalasi birga: will be.
Inkor: will not be = won't be /wəʊnt biː/. Savol: Will + ega + be + …? Be joyida qoladi, faqat will oldinga chiqadi.
FUTURE SIMPLE — kelasi oddiy zamon: ega + WILL + fe'l (1-shakl). I will go there — Men u yerga boraman. Will hamma ega bilan bir xil (he will, they will) — -s yo'q, to yo'q.
Inkor: will not = won't + V1 (I won't play). Savol: Will + ega + V1? (Will you come tomorrow?). Qisqa javob: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
19-darsda 'will be' o'tildi — bu o'sha will! will + be (bo'lmoq) = I will be a doctor; will + go = I will go. Ya'ni will dan keyin istalgan fe'l.

WILL vs GOING TO: will — hozir qaror qilyapsiz (I'm thirsty — I'll drink water), taxmin (I think it will rain), va'da (I will help you). Going to — oldindan reja (I'm going to visit Samarkand next month) yoki aniq belgi bor (Look at the clouds — it's going to rain).
Belgi so'zlar: tomorrow, next week/year, soon, in 2030, I think…, I promise…, probably.
formulas: S + will be + adj / a-an noun / adj+noun / place
I will be healthy. I will be a lawyer. He will be a great lifeguard. We will be at home.
Men sog'lom bo'laman. Men huquqshunos bo'laman. U zo'r qutqaruvchi bo'ladi. Biz uyda bo'lamiz.
S + will be + noun-s / adj + noun-s
We will be bodyguards. They will be strict teachers.
Biz qo'riqchi bo'lamiz. Ular qattiqqo'l o'qituvchi bo'lishadi.
I will go there. She will call you. It will rain tomorrow.

I won't play football. They won't study tomorrow.
Men futbol o'ynamayman. Ular ertaga o'qimaydi.
Will you go to Tashkent tomorrow? Will he come?
Yes, S + will. / No, S + won't.
Will it rain? — Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
What will you do tomorrow? When will they arrive?
Ertaga nima qilasan? Ular qachon keladi?
will — hozirgi qaror/taxmin/va'da; going to — reja
I'm cold. I'll close the window. / I'm going to buy a car next year.
Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman. / Kelasi yil mashina olmoqchiman.
presentation: Kelasi zamonda to be ning shakli qaysi ekan (kitobga qarang)?
will be
Will ning o'zimi? Nega be kerak?
Yo'q, will be — be 'bo'lmoq' degani, will faqat zamon belgisi
'Men sog'lom bo'laman' — to be + adjective?

'Sen rassom bo'lasan' — to be + noun? 'Biz modelyer bo'lamiz' — ko'plik?
You will be an artist. We will be models.
Bugungi mavzu? Tarjimasi? Formulasi?
Future simple; kelasi oddiy zamon; S + will + verb
'Men u yerga boraman'? 'Men futbol o'ynayman' (ertaga)?
I will go there. I will play football.

Inkor formulasi? 'Men futbol o'ynamayman'?

'Sen ertaga Toshkentga bormaysan'?

Teacher's book: 'oson o'rganib olyapsizlar' — lekin will va going to farqi qiyin; A1 da 2 ta oddiy qoida yetadi: reja → going to, hozirgi qaror/taxmin → will.
'I'll' qisqartmasini og'zaki nutqda ishlating: I'll help you. Yozuvda ham ruxsat.
'Will you…?' — iltimos ma'nosi ham bor: Will you open the door? (bu keyinroq).

lessons.title: CONDITIONALS (TYPE 0 AND 1)
lessons.grammar_topic: Shartli gaplar: If + present simple, present simple (0) / If + present simple, will (1)
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 22 (A–E mashqlari, zero/first — 80 gap), Common nouns (davomi), Writing 'Hometown'; Teacher's book: Lesson 20. Listening: yo'q (N/A).
objectives: Zero conditional (umumiy haqiqat): If you heat water, it boils — tuzadi.
First conditional (real kelajak sharti): If he comes, we will go to the park — tuzadi.
If-qism gap boshida bo'lsa vergul, oxirida bo'lsa vergulsiz ekanini biladi.
If dan keyin will YO'Q (If it will rain — XATO) qoidasini biladi.

materials: Conditional jadvali (kitob Level 22).

timeline: How are you? Natijalar. 'If it is sunny tomorrow, what will you do?' — ustoz namuna.
Zero: if + present, present (tabiat qonuni, doim). First: if + present, will (real kelajak). Vergul. If dan keyin will yo'q.
Rasm → so'z → 'If you are tired, sit on the sofa'. Xona bo'yicha: living room / bedroom / kitchen.
2 kishilik: 2 formula × 2 tartib (if oldinda / orqada). 1 daqiqada 2 marta — 2 coin (kitob).

intro: CONDITIONAL — shartli gap: IF (agar) qatnashgan gaplar. Ikki qism: if-qism (shart) va asosiy qism (natija).
ZERO CONDITIONAL — doim to'g'ri narsalar, tabiat qonunlari, odatlar: If + present simple, present simple. If the sun shines, ice melts (quyosh charaqlasa, muz eriydi). If I am tired, I sleep.
FIRST CONDITIONAL — kelajakdagi real shart: If + present simple, will + V1. If he comes, we will go to the park (u kelsa, parkka boramiz). If it rains, I will stay at home.
Tartib: if-qism oldinda → VERGUL: If it rains, I will stay. If-qism orqada → vergulsiz: I will stay if it rains.
MUHIM: if dan keyin will YO'Q, present simple: If it WILL rain — XATO; If it rains — to'g'ri. He/she/it da -s esdan chiqmasin: If he comes.
formulas: If the sun shines, ice melts.
Ice melts if the sun shines.
If he comes, we will go to the park.
We will go to the park if he comes.
If you don't study, you won't pass.
What will you do if it rains?
presentation: Bugungi mavzu? Nechta shakli bor?
Conditionals; 2 — zero va first
Conditional deganda qaysi so'z qatnashadi?
if
Zero conditional qanday yasaladi? Present simple qanday yasalardi (takror)?
If + present simple, present simple; S + V (he/she -s)
'Quyosh charaqlasa, muz eriydi'? Bu tabiat hodisasimi?
If the sun shines, ice melts; ha
'Ice melts' ni oldinga qo'ysak, if qism orqaga o'tsa nima tushib qoladi?
vergul
First conditional qanday? Future simple qanday yasalardi?
If + present simple, future simple (will); S + will + V
'U kelsa, biz parkka boramiz'?
If he comes, we will go to the park
If dan keyin will qo'yamizmi? 'If it will rain' — to'g'rimi?
Yo'q; xato — If it rains
'U futbol o'ynasa, biz yutamiz'?
If he plays football, we will win
Bu gaplar IELTS uchun nega foydali?
Murakkab gap — yuqori ball
notes: Zero va first farqini oddiy bering: zero — 'doim shunday' (fizika, odat), first — 'ertaga bo'lsa'. Chuqur nazariya kerak emas.
Kitobdagi 80 ta gapning hammasini bermang — 20 tasi sinfda, 20 tasi uyga; qolgani kuchli o'quvchilarga.
'If' ni 'when' bilan adashtirish — 18-darsda (conjunctions) qaytadi.
Writing 'Hometown' — reja: qayerda, qanday joy (there is/are, sifatlar), odamlar nima qiladi (present simple), nega yoqtirasiz, kelajakda (will).

If he comes, we will go.

reading.title: If it rains on Sunday
text: My family always makes plans for Sunday, but our plans depend on the weather. If it is sunny, we go to the park and have a picnic. My father plays football with my brother and my mother reads under a tree. If it is very hot, we go to the swimming pool.
If it rains, we stay at home. My mother cooks something delicious and we watch a film together. If there is no electricity, we play chess by candle!

This Sunday my cousins from Tashkent will come. If they come in the morning, we will go to the mountains. If they come late, we will stay in the city and visit the museum. If they don't come, I will be sad — but I will call them and we will talk a lot.

lessons.title: SUBJECT vs OBJECT PRONOUNS + LIKE / WOULD LIKE
lessons.grammar_topic: Ega olmoshlari (I, you, he…) va to'ldiruvchi olmoshlari (me, you, him…); like + V-ing/noun, would like + to V/noun
lessons.book_ref: Student's book: Level 18 (jadval, Common errors, me/you/him mashqlari), Sports and exercise (50), Reading Topic 36–43; Teacher's book: Lesson 17. Listening: Audio 65–69. Level 19 (like / would like).
objectives: Ega olmoshi (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) gap BOSHIDA, to'ldiruvchi olmoshi (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) fe'l/predlogdan KEYIN kelishini biladi.
'He knows me', 'I play with them', 'Give it to her' kabi gaplarni to'g'ri tuzadi.
Otni olmoshga almashtiradi: 'Lisa called John' → 'She called him'.
with / for / to dan keyin doim object pronoun kelishini biladi (with them, for us).
20 ta CORE sport so'zini biladi; 'About my friend' writing normativini va 'About myself' speaking normativini topshiradi.
like (umuman yoqtiraman) va would like (hozir xohlayman) farqini biladi: I like tea. I would like a cup of tea.

intro: SUBJECT PRONOUN — ega olmoshi: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Gapning EGASI — doim gap boshida. OBJECT PRONOUN — to'ldiruvchi olmoshi: me, you, him, her, it, us, them — fe'ldan yoki predlogdan KEYIN, gap o'rtasida/oxirida.
Tarjimada farq: I — men, me — meni/menga; he — u, him — uni/unga; they — ular, them — ularni/ularga.

Common errors (kitob): 'I play with THEM' — o'zbekchada 'ular bilan' (ular = they deb o'ylab xato qilinadi). Predlogdan keyin (with, for, to, about) DOIM object pronoun: with them, for us, to me, about her.
You va it ikkala ustunda bir xil: You love me — I love you. It is nice — I like it.

LIKE — yoqtirmoq, yaxshi ko'rmoq (umuman, doim): I like football. I like playing football (like + V-ing). WOULD LIKE — xohlamoq (hozir, muloyim): I would like a hamburger. I would like to play football (would like + to + V).
Qisqartma: I'd like = I would like. Savol: Would you like…? (muloyim taklif) — javob: Yes, please. / No, thank you. 'Do you like…?' esa umuman yoqtirish haqida: Do you like tea? — Yes, I do.
would like hamma ega bilan bir xil: I'd like, he'd like, they'd like (would o'zgarmaydi, -s yo'q).
formulas: I / you / he / she / it / we / they + verb
I am clever. She plants flowers. They call clients.
Men aqlliman. U gul ekadi. Ular mijozlarga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
verb + me / you / him / her / it / us / them
He knows me. I respect her. People call them.
U meni biladi. Men uni hurmat qilaman. Odamlar ularga qo'ng'iroq qiladi.
with / for / to / about + object pronoun
I play with them. He takes gifts for us. Give it to me.
Men ular bilan o'ynayman. U biz uchun sovg'a oladi. Uni menga ber.
She loves him. We help them. They know us.
U uni sevadi. Biz ularga yordam beramiz. Ular bizni biladi.
Lisa called John. → She called him.
The teacher praised the students. → She praised them.
Ustoz o'quvchilarni maqtadi. → U ularni maqtadi.
I like hamburgers. She likes football.
Men gamburgerni yoqtiraman. U futbolni yoqtiradi.
I like playing football. He likes reading.
Men futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. U o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.

reading.title: My team
text: I play football for the school team. Our coach is Mr Karimov. He is strict, but we love him. He teaches us a lot and he never shouts at us.
My best friend Bobur is in the team, too. He is a goalkeeper. The ball never gets past him! I play with him every day and I learn a lot from him.
We train three times a week. First we warm up, then we do push-ups and run. After training we cool down and the coach talks to us about the game.

On Saturday there is a big tournament. Our parents always come and watch us. My mother doesn't understand football, but she loves it because I play it! Do we win? Not always. But we always have fun, and that is important for us.

lessons.grammar_topic: Egalik sifatlari (my, your, his…) + ot / egalik olmoshlari (mine, yours, his…) otsiz

intro: SIFAT otni tasvirlaydi va OT BILAN keladi; OLMOSH otning O'RNIDA keladi. Egalik shakllarida ham shunday.
POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVE (egalik sifati) + OT: my book (mening kitobim), your house, her pet, his friend, its tyre, our anniversary, their toys.

POSSESSIVE PRONOUN (egalik olmoshi) — OTSIZ, '-niki': This book is mine (meniki). That house is yours (seniki). The cat is hers (uniki). The dog is his (uniki). The anniversary is ours (bizniki). These toys are theirs (ularniki).
Jadval: my → mine | your → yours | his → his | her → hers | its → (yo'q) | our → ours | their → theirs. his ikkalasida bir xil; its ning olmoshi yo'q.
its (uning — egalik) ≠ it's (it is / it has). The car lost its tyre. / It's my car.
Savol: Whose book is this? (kimniki?) — It's mine. / It's Aziz's. Whose is this? — Hers.
Ikki tomonini yodlang: TARJIMASI va undan keyin NIMA KELISHI (ot bormi, yo'qmi).

reading.title: Two families, one street
text: The Karimovs and the Rahimovs live on the same street in Bukhara. Their houses are similar, but their families are very different.

My name is Dilnoza Karimova. Our family is big: my parents, my three brothers and me. My father is a doctor. He is calm and reliable. My mother is a teacher; she is cheerful and very organised. My brothers are sporty and a bit noisy — their room is always messy, but mine is tidy! Our grandmother lives with us. She is wise and talkative, and her plov is the best in the street.

Our neighbours, the Rahimovs, are a small family. Mr Rahimov is a driver. He is punctual and a little bossy. His wife is an artist; she is creative and easy-going. Their only son, Timur, is my age. He is curious and ambitious — he wants to be an engineer. Their cat, Murka, is naughty: yesterday it ate our fish! 'Its favourite food is fish,' Timur said. 'Sorry — it was ours, now it's hers!'
We are different, but we help each other. Their car is old, so my father drives them to the market. Our garden is small, so we have picnics in theirs. Good neighbours are like family.

intro: DETERMINERS (ko'rsatish olmoshlari) — narsani KO'RSATIB aytamiz: bu / anavi / bular / anavilar.
THIS + birlik (yaqin): This pen is mine — bu ruchka meniki. THAT + birlik (uzoq): That book belongs to my friend — anavi kitob do'stimniki.
THESE + ko'plik (yaqin): These shoes are comfortable — bu oyoq kiyimlar qulay. THOSE + ko'plik (uzoq): Those flowers are beautiful — anavi gullar chiroyli.
Yolg'iz ham keladi (otsiz): This is my bag. That is his car. These are my books. Those are their toys.
SAVOL: Is this your pen? — Yes, it is. / Are those your keys? — No, they aren't. What is this? What are those?
Vaqt bilan: this morning / this week / these days (yaqin vaqt); that day / those years (uzoq vaqt).
Telefonda: 'This is Aziz' (bu Aziz — o'zim), 'Is that Bobur?' (anavi Bobur-mi — suhbatdosh).
A LOT OF + OT: I have a lot of friends (ko'p do'stlarim bor). Fe'l + A LOT (gap oxirida): I play football a lot (ko'p o'ynayman). 'A lot of' dan keyin doim ot, 'a lot' dan keyin hech narsa.

reading.title: At the market
text: Seller: Good morning! Can I help you?
Nilufar: Yes, please. How much are these apples?
Seller: These are 15,000 soums a kilo. Those red ones over there are 20,000 — they're sweeter.
Nilufar: I'll take two kilos of these, please. And what is that? Is that a melon?
Seller: Yes, that's a melon from Khorezm. It's very sweet. This one is 30,000 and that big one is 45,000.
Nilufar: This one, please. Oh, and are those grapes fresh?
Seller: Of course! I picked them this morning. Have a look — try one.
Nilufar: Mmm, delicious. Give me a kilo of those, too. How much is that altogether?
Seller: Two kilos of apples — 30,000, this melon — 30,000, and grapes — 25,000. That's 85,000 soums.
Nilufar: Here you are. Keep the change. Thank you!
Seller: Thank you! Come back soon!
glossary: Keep the change — qaytimi kerak emas

intro: MODAL VERBS — asosiy fe'lga 'qila olmoq / kerak / mumkin' ma'nosini qo'shadigan yordamchi fe'llar. ULARDAN KEYIN TO YO'Q, -s YO'Q, asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
CAN — qila olmoq (hozir): I can swim — men suza olaman. I can't swim — suza olmayman. Can you swim? — suza olasanmi? Ruxsat: Can I come in?
COULD — qila olar edim (o'tgan): I could run fast — men tez yugura olar edim. I couldn't swim — suza olmas edim. Could you swim? — suza olarmiding? Muloyim iltimos: Could you help me?
MUST — kerak, shart: He must go — u borishi kerak. He mustn't smoke — u chekishi kerak EMAS (taqiq!). Must I help? — yordam berishim kerakmi?
MAY — mumkin (ruxsat, rasmiy): You may come in — kirishing mumkin. You may not come in — kirishing mumkin emas. May I come in? — kirsam bo'ladimi?
MIGHT — ehtimol, balki (kamroq ishonch): It might rain — yomg'ir yog'ishi mumkin. I might come — kelsam kerak (aniq emas). May ham 'ehtimol' bo'ladi: He may be at home.
Ruxsat so'rash zinasi: Can I…? (do'stona) → Could I…? (muloyim) → May I…? (rasmiy).
Modal fe'l hamma shaxsda bir xil: I can, he can, they can (he cans — XATO).

reading.title: Rules at the Aqua Park
text: Welcome to Aqua Park! Please read these rules before you enter.
Children under 12 must come with an adult. They can use the small pool, but they mustn't go into the deep pool. Everyone must take a shower before swimming.

You can bring your own towel or you can rent one at the entrance for 10,000 soums. You mustn't bring glass bottles — they can break and hurt people. You may bring food, but you can only eat in the café area.
You can't run near the pool because the floor is wet and you might fall. You mustn't jump from the sides. If you can't swim well, you must wear a life jacket — you can get one for free.
The park is open from 9 am to 8 pm. You may stay all day. Have fun and be safe!

intro: VAQT RAVISHI gapning qaysi zamonda ekanini AYTIB TURADI — bu darsda 27 darsda o'tilgan zamonlarni vaqt so'zlariga qarab tanlashni o'rganamiz.
now / at the moment / right now → PRESENT CONTINUOUS: I am reading now.
every day / always / usually / on Mondays → PRESENT SIMPLE: I read every day.
yesterday / last week / ago / in 2020 → PAST SIMPLE: I read a book yesterday. (was/were + -ing → PAST CONTINUOUS: I was reading at 8 pm yesterday.)
tomorrow / next week / soon / later / in 2030 → WILL (yoki going to): I will read tomorrow. I am going to read later.
already / just / still / yet — qisqa ravishlar fe'l OLDIDA yoki to be dan KEYIN: I have just finished (hozircha: I just finished). He is still here. I already know.
Vaqt ravishi ko'pincha gap OXIRIDA, ta'kidlansa BOSHIDA: Tomorrow I will go to Tashkent.
formulas: I read every day. She reads every day.
Men har kuni o'qiyman. U har kuni o'qiydi.
He still works here. I already know. She just left.
U hali ham shu yerda ishlaydi. Men allaqachon bilaman. U hozirgina ketdi.
presentation: Bugun nima o'tamiz? Vaqt ravishi nima?

intro: ADVERB OF MANNER (holat ravishi) — ish-harakat QAY TARZDA bajarilganini aytadi va FE'LNI tasvirlaydi.
1) S + verb + adverb: She walked carefully — u ehtiyotkorlik bilan yurdi.
2) S + verb + object + adverb: He ate his food quickly — u ovqatini tezda yedi. She reads the book carefully. (Ravish fe'l bilan to'ldiruvchi ORASIGA kirmaydi: He ate quickly his food — XATO.)
3) Adverb + adjective: The cake is incredibly delicious — tort juda ham mazali. She looks remarkably beautiful.
YASALISHI: sifat + -ly: careful → carefully, quick → quickly, slow → slowly, quiet → quietly. -y → -ily: happy → happily, easy → easily. -le → -ly: gentle → gently, simple → simply.
ISTISNOLAR: good → WELL (She speaks English well). fast → fast, hard → hard, late → late, early → early (o'zgarmaydi). hardly = 'deyarli … emas' (hard emas!).
SIFAT yoki RAVISH? Sifat — OT yoki to be/look/feel bilan: She is a careful driver. The soup smells good. Ravish — FE'L bilan: She drives carefully. He cooks well.
formulas: He ate his food quickly. / She reads the book carefully.
U ovqatini tezda yedi. / U kitobni ehtiyotkorlik bilan o'qiydi.
The cake is incredibly delicious. / She looks remarkably beautiful.
Tort juda ham mazali. / U judayam chiroyli ko'rinyapti.
careful → carefully; happy → happily; gentle → gently
ehtiyotkor → ehtiyotkorlik bilan; baxtli → xursandchilik bilan; muloyim → mayinlik bilan
He works hard. She runs fast. He speaks well.
U qattiq ishlaydi. U tez yuguradi. U yaxshi gapiradi.

reading.title: The school concert
text: Last Friday our school had a concert. Everybody prepared carefully for two weeks. The teachers worked hard and the students practised diligently every afternoon.

Madina sang first. She was nervous at first, but she sang beautifully and the audience listened silently. Then Jasur played the guitar — he played incredibly well, and everybody clapped loudly. Two girls from the fifth grade danced gracefully; they moved so smoothly that it looked easy.

Not everything went perfectly. Little Ali forgot his poem and stood quietly on the stage. But the teacher smiled kindly, whispered the first line softly, and Ali finished the poem confidently. The audience cheered enthusiastically.
At the end the headmaster spoke briefly: 'You worked seriously and you did it well. I am proud of you.' We went home happily. It was a wonderful evening!

intro: Future continuous — kelajakda ANIQ VAQTDA davom etadigan ish: 'Ertaga soat 10 da men uxlayotgan bo'laman'. Formula: ega + will be + fe'l-ing.
Uchta davomiy zamonda faqat TO BE o'zgaradi: am/is/are (hozir) → was/were (o'tgan) → will be (kelasi). Fe'l-ing hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.
Inkor: will not be = won't be + -ing. Savol: Will + ega + be + -ing? (will oldinga, be joyida qoladi — 19-darsdagi kabi).
Belgi so'zlar: this time tomorrow, at 8 tomorrow, tomorrow evening, next week at this time, all day tomorrow.

Will she be working? — Yes, she will.

notes: IXTIYORIY: guruh sekin bo'lsa — bu darsni 'davomiy zamonlar takrori' (present/past continuous) qilib o'ting, future continuous ni faqat tanishtiring.
Bu zamon A1 uchun murakkab — chuqurlashmang. Maqsad: to be ning 3 zamoni + -ing formulasini bitta tizim sifatida ko'rsatish.
Inkorda o'quvchilar 'will be not' deydi — 19-darsdagi eslatma: not — will dan keyin.
Savolda 'Will be you…' xatosi — be ni doskada aylantirib qo'ying: Will you BE …?
Verbs 4 bilan kitobdagi fe'llar ro'yxati tugaydi. Keyingi darsdan (12) otlar boshlanadi. 23-darsda hamma fe'llar takrorlanadi.

reading.title: Tomorrow is a big day
text: Tomorrow is a big day for my family. At 6 o'clock in the morning my father will be driving to the airport. My uncle is coming from Moscow! At 8 my mother will be cooking a big breakfast and my sister will be cleaning the house. She won't be happy — she hates cleaning!

At 10 I will be sitting in my English lesson. I won't be sleeping — the teacher is very strict. At 12 my brother will be playing football at the stadium. It will be hot, so he will be drinking a lot of water.

In the evening we will all be sitting at a big table. My grandmother will be telling old stories and everybody will be laughing. What will I be doing at 10 in the evening? I will be sleeping, of course!

lessons.book_ref: Student's book: CHECK-LIST FOR IELTS 1.0; tests/exit test; Reading Topic 119–120. Listening: Audio 129–130.

intro: IELTS 1.0 CHECK-LIST — 27 mavzu 5 blokda: (1) TO BE: am/is/are, was/were, will be; this/that; my/your. (2) DAVOMIY: am/is/are + V-ing, going to, was/were + V-ing, will be + V-ing. (3) ODDIY: present simple (do/does), past simple (V2 / did), will. (4) OT VA OLMOSH: a/an, countable/uncountable, there is/are, some/any, a lot of, subject/object pronouns, possessives, determiners. (5) BOSHQA: imperative, can/must/may/might, conditionals 0/1, conjunctions, like/would like, adverbs (frequency, time, manner).
Har mavzu uchun 3 shakl: TASDIQ — INKOR — SAVOL. Exit testda har mavzudan shu 3 shakl so'raladi.
Eng ko'p xato: (a) to be bilan fe'lni aralashtirish (I am go); (b) 3-shaxs -s ni unutish; (c) did dan keyin V2 (did you went); (d) modal + to; (e) vaqt ravishi ↔ zamon nomosligi.

reading.book_ref: Kitobdan: Reading Topic 119–120 (uyga) + istalgan 3 ta eski topic qayta o'qish.
reading.title: My first year at Jony Academy
text: My name is Sardor. I am fourteen years old and I am from Bekobod. Last September I started IELTS 1.0 at Jony Academy. On the first day I was very nervous because I didn't know any English.

Now I can say many things. I get up at 7 every day, I go to school and in the afternoon I come to the academy. My favourite lessons are the Kahoot games — we play on our phones and the fastest student wins coins.
Last month we had Progress test 4. I was studying every evening, so I got 92%. My teacher said, 'Well done, Sardor! You will be a good student in IELTS 2.0.'
Tomorrow is our exit test. I am a little worried, but I am going to do my best. If I pass, my parents will buy me a new bike. Wish me luck!
glossary: do my best — qo'limdan kelganini qilmoq
